source.title: OS Downloads API — OS OpenMap–Local SX GeoPackage exact window
source.source_window_hash_basis: canonical selected official OS Downloads API URL + observed retrieval status WEB_URL_INACCESSIBLE_AND_DIRECT_DNS_RESOLUTION_FAILED; no raw GeoPackage bytes received

evidence_slice: Ordnance Survey's previously verified official OS OpenMap–Local documentation establishes that the OpenData product contains generalized building geometry, important buildings and functional-site information, and that OS OpenData Downloads API endpoints do not require an API key. For this batch the distinct exact OS Downloads API window for product OpenMapLocal, area SX, format GeoPackage was requested. The web retrieval channel reported the URL inaccessible, and a direct network request failed DNS resolution before any response payload was available. No feature rows, geometry, classification or distinctiveName values were fabricated or spatially joined.

field_evidence.footprint: OS OpenMap–Local documentation verifies generalized building geometry in the product, but this exact SX GeoPackage API window yielded no readable payload, so no record-level polygon was observed.
field_evidence.type_use: OS OpenMap–Local documentation verifies important-building/functional-site semantics; no record-level classification or distinctiveName value was read from this exact window.
field_evidence.identity: Exact official OS Downloads API product/area/format window selected: OpenMapLocal / SX / GeoPackage; no record payload was returned.
